TASK_ACK.objective: Formalise the C-9 proposal: define how LEGEND represents static, derived and transitional state, incorporating the state-error vs stale-transition-state distinction, and covering the four elements the operator's addendum requires.
TASK_ACK.review_requirement: R4 / MIRROR_REQUIRED — the proposal is methodology-touching and must be reviewed before anything it proposes is implemented
TASK_ACK.scope_limit: Proposal only. NO implementation, NO governance modification until the review completes. L2 remains suspended. The status/C-8 batch remains frozen pending a later operator decision.

TASK_CLAIM.timestamp_precision: date only — the runtime exposed no wall-clock time
TASK_CLAIM.uniqueness: no competing claim exists for this TASK_ID + GENERATION

PROVENANCE_OF_THE_DIRECTIVE.relay_disclaimer: The relaying actor declared itself a channel and not an authority, held no lease, issued no Task Contract, and explicitly stated the relay did not lift Plan's standing operator instruction.
PROVENANCE_OF_THE_DIRECTIVE.plan_handling: Plan did not treat either relay as authorisation. The substance was worked and delivered in the operator's own channel; nothing was written until the operator confirmed the directive directly.

WRITE_PERIMETER.reason: Both are declared CONTROL_PLANE_ROOTS in plan_defined_parameters.md § P5.1, so writing here modifies no content domain artifact and perturbs no candidate content hash and no role fingerprint.

deliberately_not_touched.roles/, governance/ (except candidates/): content domain, and the hold forbids governance modification until the review completes
